Every parrot is either honest, with every statement true, or a liar, with every statement false. You know exactly how many are lying. One did the deed.

Click a beak to mark its bird honest (green), lying (red), or unmarked. Statements that cannot hold under your marks turn red. Some birds need a question before volunteering information. You have only one or two questions; choose ones that distinguish the possibilities.

When sure, name the culprit. Every table is solvable by reasoning alone. Keys 1–7 mark birds; Enter continues. Records shows your results.
